title: Widow's Peak Fire Lookout
intent: A small hillside station clusters around a steep but bounded path and a tall lookout. Investigations span hut, ruined station and clearing; the tower is an optional risky observation branch.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Contour return avoids requiring a retreat down the same narrow ascent. Tower has one guarded stair route and a visible warning before ascent; no mandatory anchor, rite or objective may depend on surviving a blocked cab.
systems: Wind exposure increases above the clearing. Radio, sighting table and ordinary weather instruments belong to station history, not free player equipment. Lightning exposure must be telegraphed and bounded.
campaign: Final transmission transcript in station and sighting log in cab. A mission can investigate the transmissions without forcing a tower climb during a hunt.
refine: Refine tower into at least four actual stair flights with landings; the two diagram connectors are grouped reservations.
The single tower exit is a deliberate risk requiring playtest; do not promise hunt fairness from graph connectivity.
Hillside grades and contour return need terrain support and collision tests.
